formats.key: Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: Sets the spender's allowance over the owner's USDT0 to exactly `value`, replacing any earlier allowance (TetherTokenV2._permit -> _approve(owner_, spender, value)).
Uses up the owner's current permit nonce, so the signature works only once (_useNonce(owner_)).
The signature cannot be used after `deadline` (require(block.timestamp <= deadline)).
Anyone can submit the signature. No tokens move when it is submitted; the spender can later use transferFrom up to `value`.
formats.shown: "Authorize spending of tokens", then the spender address, the maximum amount in USDT0 ("Unlimited" at 2^255 or more), the expiry date and the owner. The nonce is hidden.

findings.title: Permit has no interpolatedIntent, so the intent line does not name the spender or the amount.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json format Permit: intent "Authorize spending of tokens", no interpolatedIntent. Cases 0 and 1 show the spender and the amount only as separate fields.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent "Allow {spender} to spend up to {value} until {deadline}".
